failed_cases_preserved.failure: HTTP 503 while concurrently attaching Omni workers to the multiprocess router; failure precedes learner initialization.
failed_cases_preserved.reproduced_mechanism: The native data plane rejects more than 16 simultaneous admin forwards per process. A four-process router receiving a 64-request burst reproduced HTTP 503 with 'too many concurrent admin requests'. Shared-socket distribution is not guaranteed even.
failed_cases_preserved.attribution_limit: The original GPU exception records the status and URL, not the response body. The same-scale CPU reproducer identifies a matching failure mechanism; repaired GPU execution is still required for acceptance.
failed_cases_preserved.repair: Size bounded per-data-plane admin admission to max(128, 2 * worker_count); preserve request-body limits, separate forwarding and heartbeat pools, and the all-data-plane snapshot acknowledgement fence. No retries or sleeps hide a publication race.

failed_cases_preserved.failure: Generation rollout 8: native router reported upstream ReadError for 10.254.9.137:15115 and returned HTTP 502; training stopped without completing the 25-update case.
failed_cases_preserved.root_cause_status: Unresolved below the HTTP transport boundary. No pre-error actor disconnect in the affected node's Ray logs, no ERROR/Traceback in its worker stderr logs, and cgroup oom/oom_kill counters both zero at capture. These observations do not prove the absence of a transient network or frontend fault.
failed_cases_preserved.not_the_previous_failure: Eight real updates and successful policy publications distinguish this from the prior initialization-time admin-forward 503.
failed_cases_preserved.partial_result_use: Diagnostic only; invalid for accepted throughput, scaling or stability claims.
failed_cases_preserved.profiling: The read-only profiler never attached: the case failed before its final-rollout trigger.
failed_cases_preserved.next_action: One independent repeat with the exact same pinned router/runtime/configuration after the already admitted eight-process run; preserve failed attempt and do not add generation retries to mask errors.

existing_valid_measurements.method: 25 actual updates; 21 steady adjacent-generation-start intervals, excluding the first three updates and the unclosed final interval. Initializations are excluded, training and weight publication are included.
existing_valid_measurements.interpretation: Original configuration does not show near-linear end-to-end scaling at fixed B4096. Doubling ASR replicas alone did not improve the 64-GPU result. Multiprocess-router performance remains unmeasured; no speedup claim is made for the repair.
